notes:
Denomination resolved 2026-09-10, replacing the 'Independent / non-denominational (verify)' placeholder. The about page lists 'Resonate Global Mission / Christian Reformed Church' and 'Classis AZ / Christian Reformed Church' among its partnerships, and the CRCNA church directory carries Mission Church, Tucson (organized 2020, ~75 in attendance) with Andrew Littleton as its current minister. Tradition was therefore changed from non_denominational to presbyterian_reformed. The church also belongs to the Arizona chapter of The Gospel Coalition and the Surge Network, and is worth describing publicly as 'Reformed / CRCNA' rather than 'non-denominational'.

Address 2435 E 17th St, Tucson AZ 85719 re-confirmed on the about page footer; coordinates already verified and unchanged.

Leadership, from the about page (accessed 2026-09-10): Andy Littleton, 'Pastor - Local Focus' is the only pastor. The rest of the staff hold non-preaching titles - Karen Henley (Community Coordinator), Mike Almeroth (Creative Director), Angi Murray (Family Ministry Director), Lonny and Missy Kitchell (Discipleship / Community Co-Directors), Cruz Menchaca (Intern - Outreach), Kevin Copp (Intern - Teaching / Leadership). Two of those are worth watching for pulpit time: Kevin Copp as the teaching intern, and Lonny Kitchell, whose bio says he previously served as a youth and preaching pastor in the Pacific Northwest. Neither is recorded as a pastor here because the site does not say they preach at Mission. The CRCNA directory also lists two PAST ministers - Nick H. Lang (2020-2022) and John T. Simon (2021-2024) - so sermons from 2020-2024 may not be Littleton's; check attribution before building a corpus. The individual /leaders/<name>/ pages on the site are stubs dated 2016 with no role text; the about page is the authoritative staff list, so Littleton's bio_url was pointed there.

Media: every message is published as a podcast episode at missionchurchtucson.com/podcast/. The index page does not print speaker names, but individual episode pages do (e.g. 'Wisdom - Power In Public', 2026-09-06, speaker Andy Littleton), and there is an author archive for Littleton. A YouTube channel also exists (@missionchurchtucson, channel ID UCcLdGEIzS2M4OY9D4RxlpNA). Recent series: 'Wisdom' (Proverbs, 2026), 'As We Go', 'Who We Are', 'Encountering Jesus'. Andy Littleton also writes and publishes books on a personal site, which gives an independent non-sermon writing sample for AI-signal baselining. The seed record's other_media link pointed at a single episode; it now points at the archive index.
